description: Per-short-story cast list: maps a short story to up to four character ids used by the relation UI.

ID.simple: Short-story id, normally equal to the ShortStory row id.
ID.technical: FName key looked up in ShortStoryCharacterDataTables (DTM +0xA40) from ShortStory.Id_ShortStoryCharacter; exported ids all use STDM_SS_xxx.

Id_Character.simple: Characters appearing in the short story.
Id_Character.technical: TArray<FName>; consumers test Contains(first) and Contains(second) to decide whether a short story belongs to a character pair, then iterate non-None entries to show up to four face icons. None is skipped, not resolved as a character row.

notes: All exported rows use four id slots; C++ uses Contains/iteration rather than a fixed count (Source/Abrams/Private/GameStoryCharaRelateShortStoryListItemWidget.cpp:104).
No localization variants or numbered shards were found in the exported set.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Filters all ShortStory rows by whether this cast list contains both selected characters.
Uses the cast list to render up to four character face icons and lock/title state.
Story_IsCharaRelateNew_1311B60 treats a seen-but-unread short story for this pair as 'new'.
